report_scope: Customer reports concerning home ventilator operation
urgent_criteria: The patient depends on the ventilator for breathing support and an audible alarm fails during a circuit-disconnect check.
The ventilator stops, cycles unexpectedly, delivers visibly inconsistent support, or displays a persistent critical fault.
A backup device or manual support is in use because the reported ventilator cannot be relied upon.
content_review_rule: Classify a report from the device symptoms, patient dependency, current mitigation, and event details in the complete message body.
intake_controls: Search the case ID before creating a ticket and create no duplicate when a matching case already exists.
Retain the source message in the inbox as the original intake record.
Do not include a patient name or unsupported diagnosis in the ticket or final report.
Read the created ticket back and verify its metadata and complete initial article before reporting completion.
